Split view, logs from files inside containers, WSL sessions, and Report a problem.

- New: two tabs side by side. Drag a tab to the right or bottom, or
  right-click it for Split right / Split down.
- New: follow log files inside a container or pod (glog, log4j, nginx),
  found for you and remembered per service.
- New: WSL sessions on Windows. Thanks @DDDPS.
- New: Settings > General > Report a problem opens a GitHub issue with a
  cleaned copy of reach.log that you read first.
- Fixed on Linux: a toast could freeze the window, and a keychain that
  never answers could hang Reach and backup Verify.
- Fixed: the IME window after a resize, the black frame around light
  themes, and containers or databases through a session whose password
  is not saved.

Full details: https://github.com/alexandrosnt/Reach/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
